_note: v3.0 43 T live check, no backend: group Regenerate after the story's own trailing note (owner 2026-11-01, ST controls may change). Same setup as v30-hf-regen-lane plus one player row (announce on, /cp set, a /sendas reply fires camp -> dawn, ST's Generate('normal') with no backend posts the note under the reply, so the note is the last row). The note carries extra.so_row. Control: #so-regenerate-own-rows off, ST's Regenerate as a pointer click deletes nothing (stops at the note). Fix: switch on, the same click removes the note, then ST deletes the reply above back to the player row. Run: node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts run <no-model lane> -- scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v30-43t-regenerate-own-rows.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator".

requires.why: the group Regenerate path needs a group chat; no reply is generated

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (!ctx.groupId || !ctx.chatId) throw new Error('needs a sandbox group chat'); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); return { groupId: ctx.groupId, chatId: ctx.chatId, online: ctx.onlineStatus };

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0 }); const g = rt.getGlobalSettings(); if (g.image?.enabled !== false || g.sprites?.enabled !== false) throw new Error('images or sprites are on'); const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const briefing = document.querySelector('dialog#so-briefing[open]'); if (briefing) { document.querySelector('[data-so=briefing-close]')?.click(); await wait(600); } if (!document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]')) document.querySelector('#so-drawer .drawer-toggle')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-workspace-context-orchestrator'); i += 1) await wait(150); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-context-orchestrator')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-workspace-page-display'); i += 1) await wait(150); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-page-display')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-announce-transitions'); i += 1) await wait(150); if (!document.querySelector('#so-announce-transitions')) throw new Error('#so-announce-transitions not rendered'); globalThis.__hfAnnounceBefore = g.display.announceTransitions; return { before: g.display.announceTransitions };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); for (let i = 0; i < 20 && rt.getGlobalSettings().display.announceTransitions !== true; i += 1) await wait(150); if (rt.getGlobalSettings().display.announceTransitions !== true) throw new Error('announce did not land'); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]')?.close(); await wait(400); return { announce: true, open: [...document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open]')].map((d) => d.id) };

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" raw=false The campfire crackles at the edge of the road.
/sendas name=Arin raw=false Arin pokes the fire. The road was quiet, he says, too quiet.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rows = ctx.chat.map((r, i) => ({ i, name: String(r.name), system: Boolean(r.is_system), user: Boolean(r.is_user), mes: String(r.mes).slice(0, 60) })); const last = rows.at(-1); if (last.system || last.name !== 'Arin') throw new Error('after the transition the last row is not Arin\'s reply: ' + JSON.stringify(rows)); if (rows.some((r) => r.system)) throw new Error('the note was posted at once: ' + JSON.stringify(rows)); globalThis.__hfLane = { anchor: last.i }; return { stage: 'transition fired, note queued', checkpoint: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId ?? null, rows };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const before = ctx.chat.length; let outcome = 'resolved'; try { await Promise.race([ctx.generate('normal'), new Promise((_, rej) => setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('timeout')), 30000))]); } catch (e) { outcome = String(e?.message ?? e); } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const rows = ctx.chat.map((r, i) => ({ i, name: String(r.name), system: Boolean(r.is_system), user: Boolean(r.is_user), mes: String(r.mes).slice(0, 60) })); const anchor = globalThis.__hfLane.anchor; const note = rows[anchor + 1]; if (!note?.system) throw new Error('GENERATION_STARTED normal did not post the note under the reply: ' + JSON.stringify(rows)); if (rows.slice(anchor + 2).some((r) => r.system)) throw new Error('a second system row: ' + JSON.stringify(rows)); const marker = ctx.chat[note.i]?.extra?.so_row; if (marker !== 'note') throw new Error('the note row carries no so_row marker: ' + JSON.stringify(ctx.chat[note.i]?.extra)); if (rows.length !== note.i + 1) throw new Error('the note is not the last row: ' + JSON.stringify(rows)); globalThis.__t = { anchor, note: note.i }; return { stage: 'note posted, now the last row', outcome, marker, online: ctx.onlineStatus, added: ctx.chat.length - before, rows };

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); if (!document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]')) document.querySelector('#so-drawer .drawer-toggle')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-workspace-context-orchestrator'); i += 1) await wait(150); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-context-orchestrator')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-workspace-page-display'); i += 1) await wait(150); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-page-display')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-regenerate-own-rows'); i += 1) await wait(150); if (!document.querySelector('#so-regenerate-own-rows')) throw new Error('#so-regenerate-own-rows not rendered'); return { regenerateOwnRows: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().display.regenerateOwnRows };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); for (let i = 0; i < 20 && rt.getGlobalSettings().display.regenerateOwnRows !== false; i += 1) await wait(150); if (rt.getGlobalSettings().display.regenerateOwnRows !== false) throw new Error('regenerateOwnRows did not land'); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]')?.close(); await wait(400); const open = [...document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open]')].map((n) => n.id || n.className); if (open.length) throw new Error('a dialog is open: ' + JSON.stringify(open)); globalThis.__t.before = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length; return { regenerateOwnRows: false, length: globalThis.__t.before };

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await wait(4000); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const t = globalThis.__t; const rows = ctx.chat.map((r, i) => ({ i, name: String(r.name), system: Boolean(r.is_system), user: Boolean(r.is_user), mes: String(r.mes).slice(0, 60) })); const out = { stage: 'control: switch off, ST alone', before: t.before, after: rows.length, rows, checkpoint: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId ?? null }; if (rows.length !== t.before || !rows.at(-1).system || rows[t.anchor]?.name !== 'Arin') throw new Error('ST alone should stop at the note and delete nothing: ' + JSON.stringify(out)); return out;

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); if (!document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]')) document.querySelector('#so-drawer .drawer-toggle')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-workspace-context-orchestrator'); i += 1) await wait(150); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-context-orchestrator')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-workspace-page-display'); i += 1) await wait(150); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-page-display')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-regenerate-own-rows'); i += 1) await wait(150); if (!document.querySelector('#so-regenerate-own-rows')) throw new Error('#so-regenerate-own-rows not rendered'); return { regenerateOwnRows: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().display.regenerateOwnRows };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); for (let i = 0; i < 20 && rt.getGlobalSettings().display.regenerateOwnRows !== true; i += 1) await wait(150); if (rt.getGlobalSettings().display.regenerateOwnRows !== true) throw new Error('regenerateOwnRows did not land'); document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]')?.close(); await wait(400); const open = [...document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open]')].map((n) => n.id || n.className); if (open.length) throw new Error('a dialog is open: ' + JSON.stringify(open)); globalThis.__t.before = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length; return { regenerateOwnRows: true, length: globalThis.__t.before };

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const t = globalThis.__t; for (let i = 0; i < 100 && ctx.chat.length >= t.before; i += 1) await wait(150); await wait(2500); const rows = ctx.chat.map((r, i) => ({ i, name: String(r.name), system: Boolean(r.is_system), user: Boolean(r.is_user), mes: String(r.mes).slice(0, 60) })); const out = { stage: 'fix: switch on', before: t.before, after: rows.length, rows }; if (rows.some((r) => r.system)) throw new Error('the story note survived Regenerate: ' + JSON.stringify(out)); if (rows.length !== t.anchor || !rows.at(-1).user) throw new Error('Regenerate did not delete the note and the reply above it, back to the player row: ' + JSON.stringify(out)); return out;

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await wait(2000); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const snap = rt.getSnapshot(); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (ctx.chat.some((r) => r.is_system)) throw new Error('a system row came back'); return { checkpoint: snap.activeCheckpointId ?? null, boundary: snap.boundary, rows: ctx.chat.length, note: 'the transition boundary belongs to the row /cp set ran on (the player row), so deleting the reply above the note keeps Dawn' };
